appearance.elementPickerHint: When on, you can pick an element on the page and copy its component and source location.
appearance.chatWidthHint: Applies to the transcript and the composer together. In a narrow column, some of them can look the same.
appearance.transcriptRailHint: When on, the chat's right edge shows a rail of replies (squares) and your messages (circles); click one to jump to it.

approvals.description: A listed tool asks in the inbox before every call: allow or deny. Applies to every conversation.
approvals.empty: None yet. Every tool runs without asking.

upstreamFrom.env: Set by ETA_RELEASES_URL on the server

update.upstreamWarning: This decides whose code this server runs. An update downloads what is published there and runs it, and the checksum comes from the same place, so it cannot protect you from the source itself. Only use a repository you trust.
update.upstreamHint: owner/name, or a whole address such as https://<host>/api/v3/repos/owner/name. A private repository needs a token on the server: gh's login, or GH_TOKEN.
update.tokenOutranked: The saved one is not in use: {{name}} comes first.
update.tokenOtherHost: The saved one is for {{host}}, so this source does not use it.
update.tokenDescription: Reads private repositories on {{host}}. Only {{host}} is sent it. It is kept encrypted on this server and is not shown again.
update.tokenHint: It has to be able to read the repository's releases: Contents read-only on a fine-grained token, repo on a classic one. A token in the server's environment comes first.
update.checkFailed: Could not find the latest version: {{error}}

blocked.source: This server runs from source. Update the code instead.
blocked.noService: The server is not running as a service, so it could not restart after updating. Run eta-host upgrade on it.
blocked.noWindowsService: The server is not running as a Windows service, so it could not restart after updating. Run eta-host install-service in an Administrator terminal on it, or eta-host upgrade to only replace the file.
blocked.otherFile: The service runs a different file. Update from that one.

update.confirm: The server restarts and is unreachable for about a minute. It goes back by itself if something is wrong.
update.confirmRemote: The host at {{host}} restarts and is unreachable for about a minute. Nothing on this computer changes. If something goes wrong it rolls back by itself.

phase.rollingBack: The new version has a problem. Going back

screen.slow: This is taking longer than expected. The server may need a hand.
screen.rolledBackDetail: Back on {{version}}, with your data restored.
screen.broken: The update failed and the server needs a hand
screen.help: Run journalctl --user -u io.eta.host-upgrade on the server to see what happened.

host.independent: The two keep separate data. Switching doesn't move anything. The window reopens after switching.

desktopUpdate.heading: Desktop app
desktopUpdate.confirm: eta quits, swaps in the new version and opens again. The host on this computer restarts with it and is unreachable for some seconds. If it doesn't work, the old version opens as before.
desktopUpdate.confirmRemote: eta quits, swaps in the new version and opens again. The connected host isn't touched. If it doesn't work, the old version opens as before.

failed.apply: The update didn't start; this is still the current version: {{error}}
